questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS (78 MARKS) - QUESTION 1 (6 marks)
questions.question:
Define

A. Query: (2 marks)

B. Form: (2 marks)

C. Computer Programming: (2 marks)
questions.answer_guide:
A. Query: a request to a database to retrieve, filter or manipulate data; it shows only the records and fields that meet given criteria.

B. Form: a database object that gives a user-friendly screen for entering, viewing and editing the records of a table or query, one record at a time.

C. Computer Programming: the process of writing a set of instructions (code) in a programming language that tells a computer how to perform a task.

questions.answer_guide:
Steps to create the form with the Form Wizard:
   1. Open the database and select the Registration table in the Navigation Pane
   2. Click the Create tab, then More Forms, then Form Wizard
   3. Choose the fields (use >> to select all fields of the Registration table) and click Next
   4. Choose the layout (Columnar), click Next, give the form the name Registration and click Finish

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS (78 MARKS) - QUESTION 3 (7 marks)
questions.question:
Fill in the following blanks with the appropriate words from the box

[ Bound forms | Unbound forms | Communications systems | Computer network and system | Software and digital media ]

   i. ........................ include telephone, cable/broadband and television
   ii. ........................ is not linked to any underlying data or records
   iii. ........................ is linked to the data source like a table, query or SQL statement
   iv. ........................ include computer engineering, technical assistance, electronics and robotics
   v. ........................ are the primary interface to input information into a table or a query
   vi. ........................ include computer programming, computer and video games, data management and web design
   vii. ........................ is just like a label name that shows the form title.
questions.answer_guide:
i. Communications systems
   ii. Unbound forms
   iii. Bound forms
   iv. Computer network and system
   v. Bound forms (forms are the main interface for entering data into a table or query)
   vi. Software and digital media
   vii. Unbound forms (a label is an unbound control)

Note: the box has five words for seven blanks, so v and vii reuse words; check these two against the official scheme.

questions.question:
Read carefully the below Image and answer the questions.

A. Write what kind of data model element showing either conceptual data model or logical data model? (1 mark)

B. State two entities (2 marks)

C. List attributes of Customer (2 marks)

D. Indicate relationship between these Entities (1 mark)

diagram.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 520 160' style='max-width:100%;height:auto' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2'><defs><marker id='a16' markerWidth='8' markerHeight='8' refX='7' refY='4' orient='auto'><path d='M0 0 L8 4 L0 8 Z' fill='currentColor' stroke='none'/></marker></defs><rect x='10' y='20' width='150' height='110'/><rect x='360' y='20' width='150' height='110'/><path d='M165 80 H355' marker-start='url(#a16)' marker-end='url(#a16)'/><g fill='currentColor' stroke='none' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='16' text-anchor='middle'><text x='85' y='50' font-weight='bold'>Customer</text><text x='85' y='80'>Name</text><text x='85' y='108'>Number</text><text x='435' y='50' font-weight='bold'>Product</text><text x='435' y='80'>Name</text><text x='435' y='108'>Number</text><text x='260' y='68' font-weight='bold'>Sales</text></g></svg>

questions.answer_guide:
A. Conceptual data model (it shows only the entities, their attributes and the relationship, with no keys or data types)

B. Two entities:
   1. Customer
   2. Product

C. Attributes of Customer:
   1. Name
   2. Number

D. The relationship between Customer and Product is Sales (a many-to-many relationship: a customer can buy many products and a product can be bought by many customers)

questions.section: PART TWO: STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS (78 MARKS) - QUESTION 10 (10 marks)
questions.question:
A. Explain the importance of job applications and why employers need one. (2 marks)

B. Each company and the employer have a different set of criteria, needs, and fields on their application for employment template. List four main job application requirements. (4 marks)
   i. ..............................
   ii. ..............................
   iii. ..............................
   iv. ..............................

C. CV, which stands for curriculum vitae is a detailed document that showcases a person's academic and professional accomplishments. Outline four main components of CV. (4 marks)
   i. ..............................
   ii. ..............................
   iii. ..............................
   iv. ..............................
questions.answer_guide:
A. A job application gives the employer the applicant's details, qualifications and experience in a standard way, so the employer can compare candidates fairly, shortlist the best ones, and keep a record. It also lets the applicant show interest and present himself or herself for the job.

B. Any four requirements:
   i. Personal / contact details (name, address, telephone, email)
   ii. Educational qualifications
   iii. Work experience
   iv. References (and skills, a cover letter and the CV)

C. Any four components of a CV:
   i. Personal details / contact information
   ii. Career objective or personal profile
   iii. Education and training (qualifications)
   iv. Work experience, skills and references
